stop_condition:
Report HIGH only for: a record the anchored walk parses wrongly; an extractor that can still
see past the prefix boundary; a historical record that no longer parses or now parses to a
wrong value; a legitimate findings token rejected by the whitespace class; or any remaining
claim the gate makes that nothing actually checks. MEDIUM/LOW otherwise. If there is no HIGH,
say so plainly — do not manufacture one.

findings.evidence: finding_id_in_latest_artifact extracts complete comment texts without split("\n")[0], then lines 6271-6307 grep every embedded line before applying the new prefix parser. A REVIEW-ARTIFACT whose summary continues with a newline followed by a well-formed-looking REVIEW-ARTIFACT line selects that summary line via tail -1; direct reproduction selected iteration=999 and extracted token R9-F9:high instead of the real iteration=4 token R4-F1:high.
findings.description: The resolve-finding/arbitrate extractor can still cross the real artifact's summary boundary. ART_PREFIX only slices the already misselected injected line, so it does not provide the claimed boundary protection. Normalize each comment to its first line before selecting artifacts, as review-check.sh does.
